Container.Name: wellnessquest-backend
Container.Overview:
WellnessQuest backend (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 async). Serves the REST API and the Home Assistant adapter at /api/v1, and runs Alembic migrations on startup.
Requires: - A custom docker network named `wellnessquest` (create once: `docker network create wellnessquest`). - A Postgres container reachable as host `postgres` on that network (POSTGRES_DB=wellnessquest, POSTGRES_USER=wq, your strong password). - GHCR auth if the package is private: `docker login ghcr.io -u <you>` with a PAT carrying `read:packages`.
After it's healthy, seed the first users once: `docker exec wellnessquest-backend python -m app.db.seed`.
Container.Requires: Custom docker network `wellnessquest` and a Postgres 16 container on that network named `postgres`. See docs/unraid.md.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Host port that maps to the FastAPI container port (8000).

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: SQLAlchemy async DSN. Host must match the Postgres container name on the `wellnessquest` network. Update the password substring whenever you rotate POSTGRES_PASSWORD on the Postgres container.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: 32+ byte random secret for signing access tokens. Generate: python -c 'import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))'

Config.Name: FERNET_KEY
Config.Description: Fernet key used to encrypt long-lived HA tokens. Generate: python -c 'from cryptography.fernet import Fernet;print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())'

Config.Name: CORS_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated allow-list for the API's CORS layer. Include every URL your PWA / HA / curl will dial from.

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Email for the first user created by the seed script. Only read at seed time; later auth uses the DB row.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Initial admin password. The seed script Argon2-hashes it; rotate from the UI after first login.

Config.Name: PARTNER_EMAIL
Config.Description: Email for the second seeded user (optional).

Config.Name: PARTNER_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Initial partner password (optional). Leave blank to skip partner seeding.

Config.Name: ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Access token lifetime in seconds (default 15 min).

Config.Name: REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Refresh token lifetime in seconds (default 30 days).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA timezone for streak/day rollover calculations.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Python logging level (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR).
